Puzzle Lab preview

A preview of Teacher Ronny’s Puzzle Lab. It pretends to be the server: you start with 1,000 points, the names on the Hall of Legends are samples, and nothing here touches the real site. “Wake every monster” opens Killer Mode for every puzzle.

Inside: the 12 Puzzle Lab puzzles and Killer Mode that go live after the Armory, plus the new class puzzles on the “Your class” shelves (8 of 16 so far: Shape Shifter, Zero Hero, Asymptote Architect, Emoji Systems, Marble Logic, Logdoku, Log Links, Arc Links).

On the real site this button returns to the Fun Zone.
